title: Organising a park clean-up
instructionsHu: A barátaiddal szemétszedési napot szervezel a helyi parkban. Hívd meg az ír szomszédodat, mondd el a részleteket, és kérd meg, hogy segítsen. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You live in a small town in Hungary. You and some friends are organising a clean-up day in the local park next Saturday because there is a lot of rubbish there. Your new neighbour, who is from Ireland, has just come home, and you meet him in front of your house.
situation.candidateRole: You are one of the organisers of the clean-up day.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mr Kelly, your new Irish neighbour.
goals: Introduce yourself and explain what the clean-up day is and why you are organising it.
Tell him the date, the time and the meeting point.
Say what people should bring with them.
Ask him to help in some way, for example with his car or by telling other neighbours.
situation.examinerOpening: Hi there! You live next door, don't you? Nice to meet you.

followUpQuestions: A clean-up day? That sounds interesting. When and where is it?
Do I need to bring anything?
I'm busy on Saturday morning, I'm afraid. Is there any other way I can help?

usefulPhrases.en: We're organising a clean-up day in the park.
There's a lot of litter near the playground.
usefulPhrases.hu: Sok a szemét a játszótér körül.

usefulPhrases.en: We're meeting at the main gate at nine.
Please bring a pair of gloves.
It would be a great help.
